t: Bosch Expert 150mm reciprocating saw blade for efficient cutting in medium-thick metals. Built with Bosch Carbide Technology for durability, it features medium/fine pitch carbide teeth that prevent catching in thinner sheets and medium-gauge pipes. The wide blade body ensures precise, straight cuts with reduced vibration. Ideal for cutting tough metal pipes and profiles with a wall thickness of 3-8mm. Fits all S-shank (sabre/demolition) reciprocating saws.
b: Cuts Tough Steel & Stainless Steel Pipes
